headline: Shanghai Composite index records steepest one-day decline in three months
summary: The Shanghai Composite index fell 2% on Wednesday, marking its largest single-day drop in three months and reaching its lowest level since July 2025. The decline followed negative sentiment from Wall Street and broader regional market weakness.
why: The Shanghai Composite is the primary benchmark for mainland Chinese equities. Significant moves here reflect investor sentiment toward the Chinese economy and the effectiveness of local regulatory interventions.
